reason: We already have a designer and I can make our flyers in Canva myself. Five slides about measuring letters are nice to look at, but I can't see what a brand rebuild would change for a business like mine that is worth paying for.
objection: The carousel is all about their own logo and their own type. It shows no client work, no before and after, and nothing about what happens to bookings or enquiries after the rebrand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real before and after for a business like mine, such as a hotel or clinic they rebranded, with the results they got from it.
